Privacy architecture

Your career data should not be the product.

01

Local by default

Inputs and decisions use browser storage only. No account or network API is used.

02

Minimal retention

Raw job descriptions are not saved to the queue. Export and deletion stay under your control.

03

Human confirmation

Extracted facts are editable. Legal and eligibility language always triggers manual review.
